Follows Claude Code 2.1.311: a lone backslash in quotes or brackets, like `"\"` or `(\)`, no longer disappears from Claude's responses.

- desk-look draws replies (and `/desk-preview`, and Asana task notes in desk-asana) with its own markdown renderer, which still read `\"`, `\)`, `\]` and the like as escapes and dropped the backslash. It now keeps it under the same rule Claude Code 2.1.311 uses: `"\"`, `(\)`, `[\]`, `{\}`, `'\'` and `<\>` keep their backslash, while `a(\)`, `(\)b` or an opener right after bold text still read as escapes, so replies look the same as without desk-look

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-asana@cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-slack@cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`.
